About.metaDescription: Learn about Eren Teknik Engineering's founding story, mission, vision, and engineering philosophy.
About.heroSubtitle: Adding value to industrial infrastructure since the 1960s.
About.storyP1: Founded in the 1960s, Eren Teknik combines nearly half a century of experience with modern engineering approaches to develop qualified infrastructure and superstructure solutions.
About.storyP2: Specializing particularly in clean room engineering, all processes in mechanical and electrical disciplines are managed under a single roof with full integration. GMP and FDA standards, which are at the core of operations, are meticulously upheld; sterile field projects requiring high precision are successfully delivered.
About.storyP3: Rapidly adapting to the growing need for automation systems driven by emerging technological dynamics, Eren Teknik elevated its engineering capacity in this field to global standards through a strategic solution partnership with Siemens. As a natural extension of its integrated project management vision, the company incorporated the construction discipline over time — thus achieving a comprehensive engineering structure capable of managing all mechanical, electrical, automation, and construction processes from a single source.
About.storyP4: Committed to the principles of sustainable quality and 'optimum solutions,' Eren Teknik supports its decades-long knowledge base and trust-building in the sector not only through technology but also through the expert teams it has cultivated in-house. By transferring its corporate memory to new generations with the strength drawn from its roots, it continues to be a source of knowledge and trust in the engineering industry.
About.missionText: To maximize the operational efficiency of our business partners through our integrated approach that unites different engineering disciplines under one roof; and to bring every project to life at high-quality standards while adhering strictly to budget and timeline commitments.
About.visionText: To be a pioneering brand that implements innovative technologies in the engineering sector. To become a reliable and internationally sought-after solution partner that not only meets standards but also sets the industry's quality benchmarks.
